subject: Phase 5 checkpoint: cost caps, observability, Litestream restore exercise
description:
Execute the Phase 5 checkpoint gate per §9.5. This is also the V1 release gate.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All Phase 5 tests pass.
- [ ] Integration test: synthetic cost accumulation crosses soft cap → model swap verified; crosses hard cap → override flow verified.
- [ ] Logfire dashboard shows all taxonomy spans (per §6.5) for a representative end-to-end run.
- [ ] Slash commands route in zero-token paths; NL fallback works.
- [ ] Compaction triggers at configured token threshold, retains all active delegation handles, replaces older messages with a summary.
- [ ] Retention pruning empties old chunks and reclaims WAL space on schedule.
- [ ] `GET /healthz` returns 200 with all subsystems "ok" on a healthy boot.
- [ ] `launchd` plist boots Capo cleanly on Mac mini reboot.
- [ ] Litestream restore exercise: restore paired `state.db` + `dbos.db` from the same backup point; integration tests still pass.
- [ ] Spec checklist for §5.9, §5.10, §5.12, §5.13 (final notification), §6.5 signed off in `internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md` change log.

_Performance:_
- [ ] Daily cost cap accuracy: within ±$1 of Logfire-reported actual (per §6.4) — verified via `capo.budget.reconcile` span.

_Functional (V1 release):_
- [ ] Lines of Python (excl. tests) < ~800 LOC at Phase 5 close (`tokei capo/`).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: soft + hard cap flow
• Integration: span coverage check
• Integration: end-to-end Litestream restore + replay
• Performance: 1000 webhooks at 5 rps (P99 < 1s) — re-verifies §6.1
• Performance: 100 MB stdout in 60s — re-verifies §6.1
• Performance: compaction < 5s on 110K-token history — verifies §10.3

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Section 9.5 (Checkpoint Gate)
